treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Hungary and the Kingdom of Denmark for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2011), as modified by the MLI
eif_quote: Hatályba lépett 2012. VII. 19-én a 35/2012. (VII. 16.) KüM közlemény alapján.
source_title: 2011. évi LXXXIII. törvény (HU-DK DTC, Hungarian and English text), net.jogtar.hu

rates.quote: (a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership that is not liable to tax), which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends where such holding is being owned for an uninterrupted period of no less than one year;
(c) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: Article 7 – Prevention of Treaty Abuse ... Pursuant to Article 7(17)(b) of the Convention, Hungary hereby chooses to apply Article 7(4). [No reservation on Art. 7(1); MLI PPT text: 'Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted ... if it is reasonable to conclude ... that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction ...']

notes: Art. 26(2)(a): WHT on income derived on or after 1 January of the year after EIF -> 2013-01-01 (NAV and SKAT: effective 2013). EIF CONFLICT: Hungarian KüM notice 35/2012 gives 2012-07-19; Danish legal guide gives 15.07.2012; used the Hungarian official date. 0% tier requires >=10% direct holding owned for an uninterrupted period of at least one year (treaty condition, not MLI). Art. 10(2)(b): 0% for recognised pension funds (not modelled). Replaced the 1978 convention. Hungary reserved MLI Art. 8 entirely. PPT effective date from treaty map (MLI WHT effect 2022-01-01).
unverified: MLI PPT effective date (2022-01-01) taken from treaty map, not recomputed.
